meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在模拟终端里运行应用，自动录下整个操作过程，最后生成并打开一个带视频、时间线和检查结果的摘要页面。
howto.when: 当你要求对使用 kitty 图形协议的应用做无头验证、录制操作视频或生成验证摘要时触发。

say.text: 写个 verify 脚本，验证滚轮滚动时光标位置不变
say.note: 会录制视频并生成检查摘要

say.text: 用 verify-recorder 检查点击操作是否有涟漪效果
say.note: 按脚本执行并输出通过/失败

say.text: 在验证脚本里加个断言，检查帧数超过 40

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run an app in a simulated terminal, record the whole operation, and generate/open a summary page with video, timeline, and check results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a headless verification of a kitty-protocol app, recording operation video, or generating a verification summary.

say_en.text: Write a verify script to check the cursor position stays put when scrolling
say_en.note: A video and checks summary are generated

say_en.text: Use verify-recorder to check clicks show ripple effects
say_en.note: Runs the script and reports pass/fail

say_en.text: Add an assertion that frame count exceeds 40 in the verify script
say_en.note: rec.check logs it to the summary page
